notes.title: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival & Photo Gallery Update
notes.notes:
The moon of old is no longer seen, yet this moon once shone upon Lolisi.
It's the annual Mid-Autumn Festival again. Do you still remember the three types of mooncakes that Lolis made for you last year.
This year, we must also reunite with Lolis~
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ecb4630b5f2ac9aa3fb5fb50e1a6b7d7f7ccedca.png[/img]
 
[h1]Mid-Autumn Festival Update: Photo Gallery[/h1]
New feature: [b]Photo Gallery[/b] accessible from the system tray
All publicly available photos of "VPet Simulator" at the current stage have been added as task rewards.
It contains most of the images from the "VPet Simulator" including emojis, GIFs, CGs, etc.
Masters, you can unlock the corresponding pictures by completing tasks.
The tasks can be unlocked gradually through daily gameplay, and most of them can also be purchased directly with money if you don't want to grind.
Unlocking an image will trigger a notification pop-up. In the photo gallery, you can view the image details, which include the image name, unlock time, and a brief description of the image. Additionally, you can export or copy the image.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/fcb9d3a11fa65611d786fc3aa87c2bc4861085b2.png[/img]
 
The photo gallery will continue to update, solving the troubles of players who cannot obtain the original images of VPets.
[b]Note: The content in the photo gallery is not for commercial use[/b]
Finally, Lolis wishes all masters a happy Mid-Autumn Festival and a happy reunion.

Cloud save (not STEAM cloud save)

notes.title: Creative Workshop Module Update v1.10 Tutorials
notes.notes:
The mod maker will support upgrading non-code plugins to v1.10 after the update, just open the old version of the mod through the mod maker.

[h1]All mods that need to be modified[/h1]
[h2]Modify the version number[/h2]
Open Info.lps and change the version number `gamever#109:|` to 11000.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/1fe6fde04f478089ed75cc192f7c12a3ce7ae433.png[/img]

[h1]Animation/Working mod[/h1]
[h2]Modify default pet names[/h2]
(Optional: the game has added auto-compatibility for these in the code, but it would be nice to change it)
If you're animating Lolis and working on a mod, you'll need to change the id '默认虚拟桌宠' to vup
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/fc0fb48c3bd28bc434a6ccd265b785e4be2f3f43.png[/img]

[h2]New feature: Tag[/h2]
Add tags to pets, they are used to determine and differentiate speech, as long as they meet a tag (intersection > 1), they will be enabled.
The default tag for all speech is `all`, which can be modified.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/1114d1aa2684f432a8db9fdf899d9c09efb6b752.png[/img]

[h2]Work data adjustment[/h2]
If you are not sure, you can refer to Core's job data, or use a mod maker.

MoneBase Money level limit = 1.1*level + 10
MoneBase experience level limit = (1.1*level+10)*10

[h3]Get Calculation[/h3]
Money = (MoneBase *(1+FinishBonus/2)+1)^1.25
Experience = ((MoneBase *(1+FinishBonus/2)+1)/10)^1.25

[h3]Spend Calculation[/h3]
=(StrengthFood^1.5/3+StrengthDrink^1.5/4+Feeling^1.5/4+LevelLimit
/10+(StrengthFood+StrengthDrink+Feeling)^1.5/10)*3

Get/Spend Recommended less than 1.25. Limit less than 1.3

[h3]Other Limits[/h3]
Minimum working time is 10 minutes
Maximum multiplier is (2+1) times
Level limit cannot exceed 200 levels (in-game pull multiplier will not exceed 4000 levels)

[h3]The Excel sheet I used to download:[/h3]
Link: game_data_v1.10 https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1J9_9TqxQoK1zjy3usT_eXn2a5ydpY6iE/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=109742094280180815773&rtpof=true&sd=true
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/8f49d22cec2b9d7ea99b8b42168dc702a1f456c6.png[/img]
Parameters that need to be Green (True) if you want to not be supermodeled
RELTRU: Get/Spend Ratio
LIMTRU: Get Limit

[h2]Add a working image[/h2]
If not added, the default image is displayed
Work images are placed in the image\work folder
First level (image\work): If no image can be found, the default image will be displayed.
Second level (image\work\pet skin id): the image of the pet that corresponds to the work.
	For major categories (play/study/work), you need to add the 't' prefix in front.

Incidentally, in the VPet filesystem, each folder is automatically converted to '_'. 
For example "work\vpet\t\play.png" = "work_vpet_t_play.png"

[h1]Themes and fonts[/h1]
[h2]Themes[/h2]
Theme is put under theme folder, LPS structure, specific format can refer to Core module files, mainly color table and replacement pictures.
[h2]Fonts[/h2]
Fonts are placed under theme/fonts folder, ttf format is enough.


[h1]Code Plugin Mod[/h1]
The code plugin needs to be upgraded to net 8, you can use Microsoft's Upgrade Assistant to upgrade the program.
https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/porting/upgrade-assistant-overview
If you want to do it yourself, you can also refer to Microsoft's upgrade tutorials
https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/porting/

Here is the official sample code plugin MOD for example
github: https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet.Plugin.Demo

First, download and install Microsoft's official upgrade tool .
NET Upgrade Assistant https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-dotnettools.upgradeassistant

After installation, right-click the project that needs to be upgraded, and select Update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/cbcc47c2496991d893303350a52b3ad4b232ca4c.png[/img]
Choose to upgrade to the latest .net version
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/bc9e96358775671d4ee245b12419f7ecc1a654c1.png[/img]
Keep the default In-place project upgrade, and select Next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/df103c87d7d5256f49c8145db9fc9a012fdddbb8.png[/img]
Select .net 8, and choose Next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/c281315c81061c38de1115aab58fdc905822b03b.png[/img]
Then click Upgrade selection to upgrade to .net 8
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/81712e082e9c715644750fc370ad228b2454e8a2.png[/img]
Once the upgrade is complete, It is recommended to restart VisualStudio and refresh the cache to avoid vs bug.
Finally, go to nuget and upgrade to the latest version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/128b25dd15717a963bf0bf49577b1ff245ca8c8a.png[/img]
If you have any problems with the code, feel free to raise an issue on github, or if your mod is open-sourced on github, ask me to upgrade the code via @LorisYounger

notes.title: Monthly Update Summary August
notes.notes:
There's been no notification of game updates lately, not that I've been secretly update on them, but I've been too lazy to write an update document. (lol)
Details of the updated changes can be found directly in [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet/commits/main]github commits[/url]
This is real time.

[h1]Animation Updates[/h1]
[h2]New play types: play games/delete bugs[/h2]
Playing the game type doesn't drop moods, and consumes less thirst and hunger.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/6736d2bd823534e9a2248350dbbeb7abf845068e.gif[/img]

[h2]Add more advanced learning: research[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ed173236bdf4bd5f3ec18a6eed545e161a9a948f.gif[/img]

[h2]New intermediate stage work: screen clearing[/h2]
Screen clearing replaces the original live streaming, for level 10 work. Live stream changed to level 20
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/432d42db877d586816c8dcc23bb7b1a4aa0f8ff6.gif[/img]

[h2]Other new animations[/h2]
Such as dancing, new normal loop animations, sad walking, etc.

[h2]Where's the gift? [/h2]
Gifts are still working on, the code and animations are complete, just need to plan to provide gift items, the whole thing will be pushed up!

[h1]Code update[/h1]
[h2]ChatGPTAPI support for feedback based on status/good feelings[/h2]
Also supports selecting model GPT3/4
Added status and favorability parameters to the chat front to make the CGPT feedback more realistic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/71bf0f1e7b00e3d85b91053ca24851291d84addf.gif[/img]

[h2]New optional chat[/h2]
Replaces the previous official API (which cost me 80$ and I'm out of luck, so get off the line).
New Option Chat allows you to ask your table favor by selecting a fixed question, different questions and answers will affect the mood/favorability parameters
Support for Creative Workshop to add more options and answers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/424637ad58be2670b45f997ce9ada29c72baad53.gif[/img]

[h2]Hash check and supermod check[/h2]
Added features such as supermod checking and auto-calculation of supermod data. And for players who don't use supermods, a small label is provided for showing off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/7466818c7831398cc1a494e8733befcbfa4a18a0.png[/img]
If you want to restart the game, you can do so in Settings - System - NewGame.
Players don't need to worry about whether or not they're using a supermodel mod, as the default settings automatically calculate supermodel data, meaning you're unlikely to encounter problems with missing markers.
Even if you are using an overmodel mod, you don't need to worry about whether or not it will affect your achievements. 
The overmodel check does not affect the unlocking of achievements. However, using an overmodel mod may cause the game to report errors (data overflow) or prevent achievements from being unlocked properly (e.g. stats not working for negative items).

[h2]MOD supports animations for food/drinks/items[/h2]
The mod now supports animations, for example, the functional drink here becomes a drinking animation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/b4256a98c2f1d449f3434d118d84748b718c51f9.gif[/img]

[h2]Support for pets to buy their own food[/h2].
Pets will now buy their own food, but there is a take-out fee.
As for the mood response, I will change it when the gift comes out in the future.
Although the description says that the pet will eat food indiscriminately, but in fact, it will not, the pet will only eat more than $10.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/f9eaa1995d6bce8687eabf289269cc1fe56abd90.gif[/img]

[h2]MOD Maker[/h2]
It's still being tweaked, and it's actually working, but I haven't finished writing it yet (English translation, etc.).
So I haven't sent it out yet, I'll post an update when the time comes, see: [url=https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet.ModMaker]VPet.ModMaker[/url]

notes.title: Official Update Planner
notes.notes:
Since the official version of "VPet Simulator" was launched, it has gained more attention than expected, and the number of people online has exceeded that of most games, according to the current data. So we need to change the situation that we have been making games based on interest, and become slightly more formal, for me, now that the game audience is so large, the game has become everyone's game, as the saying goes, the game industry is also a service industry, and we need to serve the players as the core, instead of the attitude of my game I make the decision, which will make the game die at light speed

[h2]Core issues[/h2]
[h3]BUG[/h3]
Currently, I have fixed a lot of bugs that prevented it from starting, and a lot of bugs that reported, but there are still some bugs that prevent it from starting due to system/environmental reasons. After all, there are only one programmer, and I get tens of thousands of feedbacks every day, so I'll keep fixing these bugs according to priority and difficulty. I've also recruited some new programmers to help me maintain it.
If you know C# and WPF, you are welcome to fix the bugs together. The project address: https://github.com/LorisYounger/VPet

[h3]Creative Workshop Tutorial[/h3]
Creative Workshop tutorials are in the works, as well as a modding tool that is being developed
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/ab22516a578c09e43028788e41c4820db67c7e48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/779c13211c839abc19393ce2f195eb368e091d51.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Chat & Server[/h3]
Due to the number of people playing the game at the moment, the chat function and the servers are overloaded, and it is expected that the future chat function provided by the developers will be taken down.
The developers have changed the chat function to local chat based on options, and the planners are already designing the text. This feature will also support the Creative Workshop

[h2]Drawing of blueprint[/h2]
[h3]2023/08[/h3]
New way to chat options
Mod maker

notes.title: Monthly update summary August
notes.notes:
Here are basically code updates, and for the animation related updates that everyone is looking forward to, please pay attention to the "Official Version Forward Update" on August 11th

From June 19th to August 8th, all the updates are as follows

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]

[h3]Multi-language support[/h3]
Traditional Chinese and English are now supported, and you can subscribe to more language packs through the Creative Workshop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/96db65b9233cdee09d96cce39d12f0c20288ea1c.png[/img]

[h3]Mouse Penetration/Small Label[/h3]
Allow users to use Mouse Penetration to penetrate, the mouse can pass over the table favor to interact with the things behind.
New quick switch cursor, quick switch mouse through/on top.

[h3]Refactored animation playback system[/h3]
The playback system code has been completely refactored, and now supports customization of multiple animations and all kinds of moving/learning/working.
The new animation system is not limited to the previous system, and it is much easier to customize your pet's animations and movements.
[b]Previous animation system[/b]
* Fixed number of moves, jobs, etc.
* A large number of animations are forced to be implemented, if not, an error will be reported.
* No way to set the movement speed for each movement animation individually
[b]New version of the animation system[/b].
* Any number of jobs and moves can be customized.
* Only need to realize 7 groups of animation, you can make a simple table pet.
* Support to set the speed, limit, judgment and other settings for each move individually.
* support to set the duration of all loop animation

[h3]Stats & Achievement System[/h3]
New Stats & Achievements system, stats have been installed in beta, achievements will be unlocked automatically in the official version. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/e4fdd6f9a9251848797993091a94778675769f15.png[/img]

[h3]New hidden values display[/h3]
Show hidden satiety and thirst levels
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/7678c4359ae22ba34a2448d1a9db0d47bd0b28fc.png[/img]

[h3]New version of the chat system[/h3]
The new version of the table pet chat system will respond to table pets based on their favorability and current status.
Also favorability determines the length of the word count response generated by the table pet (when using the API provided by the table pet developer)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/461d3890f2a00386889a81553f1c4b88fae67508.png[/img]

Support to view the remaining available words today and other related information via the progress bar below the chat box.
Support to close the chat box from the menu in the settings.

[h3]Add automatic backup function[/h3]
New automatic backup feature to prevent accidental archive corruption.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43530340/764ca065bb38f587580942a5d07c32665ef8ee7c.png[/img]

[h2]The rest of the updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Support for save hash check
[*] Support feedback for untranslated docs
[*] Support translation when MOD is not loaded.
[*] Fix bugs related to animation display
[*] [b]Add function to prevent empty animation loop[/b].
[*] [b]Fixed bug where movement could not be stopped[/b]
[*] [b]Load autosave when loading an archive fails [/b]
[*] [b]Fix bug where hunger and thirst notifications are not frequent [/b]
[*] Fix corner markers not turning off
[*] Optimize the exit method
[*] Fix all feedback bugs
[*] Better buy data optimization and interface updates
[*] MOD default enable changed to disable
[*] [b]Interactive hints for mood and stamina count[/b]
[*] Interaction period for calculating intervals shown in settings
[*] [b]Fix the bug of archiving error[/b]
[*] Add animations for drinking water, thirst, sleeping, etc.
[/list]

[b]About save hash checks[/b]
Although the recent VPets update added an archive hash check to verify the integrity of the archive, this check does not affect the normal use of mods/archive modifications or the acquisition of achievements.
